title: Around The Post Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 132bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Ball is wide and low
Outside the post line
No height needed
Go around not over

[Whisper verse]
Feet sprint to the wide ball
Low stance reach with the legs
Paddle face open thirty
Grip pressure four out of ten

Contact below the net height
Outside the court line
Swing path side to side
Flat face square at impact

[Tribal drop chant]
Around the post around the post
Side and low side and low
Vamos firme pa lante
Around the post around the post

[Whisper verse]
Target the open court
Diagonal across the line
Pace medium flat path
No need to clear the net

Follow through across the body
Return to ready balanced
Recover to the line jog back
Breath out and reset eyes

[Tribal drop chant]
Around the post around the post
Side and low side and low
Vamos firme pa lante
Around the post around the post

[Whisper outro]
Wide and low
Go around
Wide and low
Go around
